## Shipped products

- Daily Skyline is a daily 5×5 skyscraper logic puzzle on the App Store. Same board worldwide each day. Marketing site: https://dailyskyline.muratoncu.com
- Courai is a CBT-based iOS app for social anxiety, built solo in React Native with Supabase. Site: https://courai.vercel.app
- codebrief is an npm CLI that generates CONTEXT.md, Cursor rules, and Copilot instructions.
